notes: Original horror story in pt-BR. Low-poly 3D at night: cold, flickering 13th floor vs the warm 14th. Titles with a red highlight. Ends on the twist (plate 1302) and loops back to the building.

scenes.label: O 13º andar
scenes.title: Meu prédio não tem 13º andar
scenes.visual: exterior: the tower at night, the camera tilts up the façade, the red beacon blinks

scenes.label: O 13º andar
scenes.title: Do 12 direto pro 14
scenes.visual: close-up of the button panel (no 13): the 12 lights up, then the 14

scenes.label: Madrugada
scenes.title: O elevador parou
scenes.visual: cabin wide: the narrator idle; a jolt, the light flickers, he gets scared and looks up

scenes.label: Madrugada
scenes.title: Um número que não existe
scenes.visual: close-up of the floor display glitching between 12 and 14, then it goes dark

scenes.label: Madrugada
scenes.title: Treze.
scenes.visual: the display lights up a red 13 (red pulse); then the doors open by themselves onto the corridor

scenes.label: 13º andar
scenes.title: Um corredor igualzinho ao meu
scenes.visual: POV leaving the elevator; tilt down to the carpet, pan to the side doors

scenes.label: 13º andar
scenes.title: Só que as luzes piscavam
scenes.visual: following the narrator down the flickering corridor; the far door is ajar

scenes.label: 13º andar
scenes.title: Apartamento 1302
scenes.visual: extreme close-up of the plate 1302; it flickers to 1402 (his) and back

scenes.label: 13º andar
scenes.title: Chamou meu nome com a minha voz
scenes.visual: close-up of his scared face; cut to the dark doorway where two white eyes open (red pulse)

scenes.label: Fuga
scenes.title: Corri pro elevador
scenes.visual: he runs toward the camera to the cabin; close-up of the 14 pressed again and again

scenes.label: Fuga
scenes.title: A porta fechou
scenes.visual: from inside the cabin: the doors close while the double stands at the end of the corridor; the display switches to 14 as it goes up

scenes.label: Em casa
scenes.title: Tranquei tudo e fui dormir
scenes.visual: the bedroom in moonlight: he lies down and closes his eyes

scenes.label: Em casa
scenes.title: Três da manhã
scenes.visual: the phone clock 03:00 on the nightstand; the elevator dings and his eyes snap open

scenes.label: Em casa
scenes.title: Três batidas na porta
scenes.visual: low at the strip of light under the door: two feet shadows arrive and stop; three knocks shake the door

scenes.label: Em casa
scenes.title: Abre, sou eu
scenes.visual: he leans on the door; the peephole shows the double in the flickering corridor, leaning closer

scenes.label: O 13º andar
scenes.title: Você entrou no apartamento errado
scenes.visual: behind the double, the camera pulls back from his door: the plate reads 1302 (red pulse, flicker)
